overall: Washington DC is currently in the pre-dawn cooling phase at 68.0°F, well below the overnight running max of 73.4°F recorded just after midnight. NWS calls for mostly sunny skies with a high near 89°F, consistent with classic summer heat-building pattern and no precipitation threat today.
forecast_obs_notes: Model agreement is notably strong today: ECMWF (88.3°F) and HRRR (88.5°F) are nearly identical, and NWS rounds to 89°F — all clustering tightly around 88-89°F. max_temp_prediction: The dominant evidence — ECMWF, HRRR, and NWS text all pointing to 88-89°F — strongly favors the 88-89°F even bucket as today's TMAX. Mostly sunny skies, south winds providing warm air advection, and no cloud/precip interruptions support a clean afternoon warming curve toward the 88-89°F zone. Confidence is moderately high given the tight NWP agreement; NBM's lower reading and the INTRADAY model's broad spread introduce some downside risk toward 86-87°F, but the preponderance of evidence favors 88-89°F.
